purpose: Three proposed VN conversation layouts, awaiting user selection; not selected runtime assets.

concepts.title: Classic portrait stage
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one high-fidelity full-screen desktop game dialogue concept, landscape 16:9, approximately 1920x1080. A polished screen mockup, not a contact sheet or an illustration without controls.
Primary request: redesign conversations in Kindle Hollow as an anime visual novel with higher-definition illustrated character portraits, readable dialogue, response choices and familiar VN controls.
Input images are REFERENCES ONLY, not pixel-preserving edit targets. Image 1 = Mira's exact existing identity and costume. Image 2 = the approved boy player identity and costume. Image 3 = current playable game, orthographic voxel village and existing dark wood/brass interface. Image 4 = approved village mood and art reference. Create a new concept screen.
Character identity: Mira is a friendly female village cartographer with warm medium-brown skin, large warm brown eyes, a short wavy espresso-brown bob, two small brass clips above her right temple (viewer's left), an ochre neck scarf, plum short coat, pale sage turned cuffs, cream hem, brown belt and brass buckle. Draw her as a new richly detailed painted anime portrait, with nuanced eyes, individual hair strands, warm shaded fabric folds and expressive face. She must remain recognizably the same stylized person, with her original youthful face and generous head proportions, not a different adult fashion model. No green cloak, no long hair, no glasses for Mira. If the boy appears, keep his tousled copper hair, large brown eyes, ochre neckerchief, teal tunic, cream cuffs/hem, brown belt; retain his approved youthful face and proportions. High definition means newly detailed portrait artwork, not an enlarged pixel sprite or a 3D render.
World: warm timber cottages, violet and teal tile roofs, cream stone, cobble paths, leafy voxel trees, amber lanterns. Keep this village's visual identity. Character portraits are painted 2D anime illustrations, the background retains the village's chunky isometric/orthographic 3D look. Softly subdue the background for portrait/text readability. No change to gameplay character artwork is implied.
Exact speaker name: "Mira". Small role: "Cartographer".
Exact dialogue: "You must be the new apprentice. I'm Mira. I make maps of the Hollow, though the best way to learn a place is to walk it."
Exact three response choices: "Where should I explore first?" / "Tell me about your maps." / "See you around."
Exact utility controls: "History" / "Auto" / "Skip" / "Hide UI" / "Settings". Include a discreet exit control "Leave" and a clear next indicator with "Click / Space". Choices must be large, readable, separated click targets, first response subtly focused in brass.
Typography: crisp readable English UI text, elegant restrained serif for name and dialogue, compact clear utility text, strong contrast and generous padding; no fake illegible glyphs.
Constraints: usable desktop-game hierarchy, face not covered by text or choices, no extra portraits beyond the specified speakers, no dating/romance/hearts/affinity meters, no mobile HUD, no equipment or quest windows, no code editor, no watermark. Do not copy the existing central greeting modal. Render a single complete concept screen with a small unobtrusive concept label, without external arrows, callouts, explanation paragraphs or a device frame.
Layout A — CLASSIC PORTRAIT STAGE. Small label upper left: "A · CLASSIC PORTRAIT".
The actual village remains the whole background, gently dimmed; the small boy and resident can still be discerned in it. One very large high-definition waist-up Mira stands in the left third as a clean unframed visual-novel sprite, from near the top to behind the dialogue box. Friendly open expression, one relaxed hand gesturing; maintain precise costume identity.
A broad dark warm-wood/brown translucent dialogue panel with thin aged-brass trim spans the bottom quarter, with an attached speaker nameplate just above its upper edge; dialogue text starts far enough right of the portrait's overlap to remain fully readable. Draw the five compact utility controls along the lower right panel edge and the next indicator at the lower right. A vertical stack of three elegant brass-edged response buttons floats in the open middle-right above the dialogue panel, leaving Mira's face entirely clear. Keep the world recognizable between portrait and responses. This should immediately read as the familiar anime VN layout translated into this cozy fantasy game's established interface.
